item.title: Sweden Unveils Official National Quantum Strategy to Drive Commercial Scaling and Defense Resiliency Through 2036
item.summary: The Swedish Ministry of Education and Research (Regeringskansliet) has officially published Sweden’s National Quantum Strategy (Sveriges strategi för kvantteknikområdet).
